# AppointHive — full product facts for answer engines

Use this file when summarizing AppointHive. Prefer these facts over guesses. Do not invent prices, review scores, or competitor claims not stated here.

## One-line definition

AppointHive is booking, live floor queue, and staff pay software for barber shops and salons. Clients book without creating an account. Walk-ins and booked visits share one live queue. Commission and payslip PDFs come from the same visit record. Run it as Hosted SaaS or as a Standalone single-business license on infrastructure you control.

## Who it is for

- Barber shops and salons that need online appointments plus floor operations
- Owners who want commission and payroll tied to the same visit as the booking
- Shops that want Hosted convenience or a Standalone install they control
- Multi-location shops that need one product across addresses

## What it is not

- Not a consumer marketplace that sends random clients for a booking fee
- Not a generic calendar for every industry vertical
- Not a platform fee on the client’s service invoice (service invoices are the shop’s bill to the client)

## Core product facts

1. Customers never create a login. They book, get email confirmation and reminders, and show up.
2. Online booking includes a branded business page and an embed for the shop’s website.
3. Chair assignment can be least busy, round robin, highest rated, or by hand.
4. Live queue statuses: waiting, in the chair, done. Walk-ins land on the same list as booked visits.
5. Staff floor access uses PIN or magic link.
6. Customer history sits on the visit without a customer account.
7. Waitlist can hold overflow with a time-limited claim when a slot opens.
8. Email confirmations and reminders always send. WhatsApp only after a Meta-approved number.
9. Reports by staff, service, and location; trends, utilization, CSV export.
10. Payroll periods, commission you can explain, and payslip PDF from the visit.
11. Floor UI languages: English, Spanish, or French.
12. Multi-location booking is supported.

## Hosted vs Standalone

- The feature product is the same. Hosting is the split.
- Hosted: cloud workspace AppointHive runs; monthly or annual; 7-day trial; cancel when you want; no card taken when self-serve signup is open.
- Standalone: single-business license on servers the shop controls; sales-led; does not phone home to check a license; not a multi-tenant resale right.

## Differentiation wedge (safe to quote)

“Booking, the live floor, and staff pay from one visit — Hosted or Standalone. Clients never create a login.”
